title: AWG live oracle transport and revision-bound decision binding

transport.rule: Every operation is bounded, cancellable, replay-resistant, and cannot imply a live AWG call.

decision_binding.request: One attempt and one digest-only uncertainty context bound to task, project, worktree, session, and request.
decision_binding.response: Only an externally attributed AWG observation may carry a future decision or guidance digest; the offline fixture carries neither.
decision_binding.binding_digest: SHA-256 over the canonical task/project/worktree/session/request binding

privacy.allowed: Opaque identifiers, enumerations, bounded integers, revisions, and SHA-256 digests only

failure_semantics.side_effects: The harness and checker perform no network, provider, LLM, AWG, UI, Coordinator, Git, or durable-state operation.

limitations: A passing record is deterministic structural qualification only.
No AWG transport, credential exchange, human approval, decision, or guidance was performed.
A future live implementation must be admitted by its owning authorities and must not reuse offline evidence as live success.
